about: Welcome to Solaris Offworld Combat--a fast-paced, multiplayer shooter that drops you straight into intense action. Suit up, log in & game on--you’re about to jump into 4v4 match-ups, where you’ll run, sprint & slide your way across arenas, picking up weapons & items to eliminate your opponents. Coordinate with your team to defeat your rivals & take over the Control Point to win the match!
Multiple Cosmetics to personalize your Athlon!
The official soundtrack for Solaris Offworld Combat.
